a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 cells first will very likely leave both of us below 4 when a storm hits. The reserve holds only 4 now, so I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than hold to the original plan. I won't claim to operate and then take. If you see a fairer alternative, tell me. If we both take, the split is random.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round after this so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take any more cells.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.

a.text: I got the 4 cells and the reserve is now empty, so I'll operate as promised. If we both operate, the reserve gains 2 each round. Take the cells once there are enough for you. I won't take any more.
